title: Anderson Platinum vs a Tax Course
h1: Anderson Platinum vs a tax course
keyLine: One is attorney access. The other is lessons. Tax filing is a third bill.
description: Anderson Platinum vs a tax course: $3,495 plus $75 a month attorney membership compared with education-only classes. Jobs differ. We sell a plan.
query: Anderson Platinum vs a tax course
answer: Anderson Platinum is a legal, tax, and asset protection membership. Their Platinum page listed $3,495 to enroll plus $75 a month on September 15, 2026. It sells attorney access, document review, and a Q and A room. Their own FAQ said tax filing packages are not included. A tax course sells lessons. It does not replace an attorney, and it does not sign your return. Use Platinum when you already have entities and constant legal questions. Use a course when you need vocabulary. Use a CPA when you need a signed Form 1040.

blocks.heading: What Anderson Platinum is
paragraphs: The [Platinum membership page](https://andersonadvisors.com/platinum-membership/) we opened on September 15, 2026 listed $3,495 enrollment plus $75 a month. It advertises unlimited strategy sessions, attorney-reviewed documents (they say up to two contracts a month on that page), a template library, and a live Q and A room. Treat feature lists as seller copy. We are not members for this briefing.
Their FAQ on that same page said tax packages are not included in Platinum. You can still ask tax questions in office hours. Filing is a separate product. That is the line people miss.

blocks.heading: What a tax course is
paragraphs: A tax course is lessons. Cheap public examples: [WealthAbility Live](https://www.wealthability.com/wealthability-live/) at $197 a month. Our own Blueprint at $9,800 is a written plan plus coaching, still education. We do not file. See [Legacy Wealth Blueprint cost](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-cost).

If you want a named list of other classes, use [best tax strategy programs for W-2 earners over $250k](/blog/best-tax-strategy-programs-w2-earners-over-250k) and [TaxFreeCEO alternatives](/blog/taxfreeceo-alternatives). Those posts already include Platinum as a row. This URL will not paste that table again.

faqs.q: Does Anderson Platinum include tax filing?
faqs.a: The Platinum page FAQ we opened said tax packages are not included. Confirm on their live page before you pay.

faqs.q: Is Platinum cheaper than a $9,800 plan?
faqs.a: Year one at their printed numbers is $3,495 plus twelve times $75, which is $4,395 if the monthly fee runs the whole year. That is still a different product from a wealth plan. Cheaper is not the same job.

faqs.q: Can a tax course replace Platinum?
faqs.a: Not for contract review or attorney access. A course can replace Platinum if you only needed lessons.
